name.description: Object name under the run prefix (e.g. `brief.json`).

uri.description: Canonical URI the host can fetch (typically a MinIO signed URL).

size.description: Object size in bytes; `0` if unknown.

contentType.description: MIME type as written at upload time.

items.description: One object inside a run's artifact bundle. URIs, not blobs.
Bundle objects, empty when the run has not been packaged yet.

runId.description: Run id the bundle belongs to.

description: One page of run-artifact pointers — wraps ArtifactPointer with the project/run id echo.
